findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_vehicles, filter_vehicles, get_vehicle, get_dealer, get_safety_rating, get_vehicle_history, dealer_inventory, research_model, get_vehicle_rankings, get_similar_vehicles · Private data: list_facets, get_vehicle, get_dealer · Public sink: search_vehicles, filter_vehicles, get_vehicle, dealer_inventory, compare_vehicles, get_similar_vehicles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_vehicles, filter_vehicles, get_vehicle, get_dealer, get_safety_rating, get_vehicle_history, dealer_inventory, research_model, get_vehicle_rankings, get_similar_vehicles · Private data: list_facets, get_vehicle, get_dealer · Public sink: search_vehicles, filter_vehicles, get_vehicle, dealer_inventory, compare_vehicles, get_similar_vehicles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
